image_description: A tall, dark wooden bookcase with glass doors on the upper section and open shelves below. The bookcase is filled with books and various objects. The structure appears to be made of polished wood with a rich, reddish-brown finish. The image has a slightly painterly or filtered aesthetic, causing some texture smoothing.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Horizontal shelves are visible dividing the vertical frame into multiple sections.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The image exhibits a strong 'oil painting' or heavy noise-reduction filter effect. While this may be stylistic, it smooths out fine details of the book spines and wood grain, which is a common artifact in AI generation trying to mimic complex textures.
The text on the book spines is illegible and structurally nonsensical. Instead of clear letters, there are blurred blobs and pseudo-text patterns, a hallmark of AI image generation.
The base of the bookcase on the left merges ambiguously with the foreground surface. The geometric lines of the furniture warp and lose definition at the bottom edge.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is classified as a bookcase and not a generic shelf or cabinet.
To verify the 3D consistency of the shelves and glass doors, ensuring they don't melt into the background.
To check for boundary bleeding between the glass reflections and the wooden frame.
To assess the severity of the painterly texture and determine if it constitutes a quality defect.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on book spines
Geometric integrity of shelf lines (parallelism and straightness)
Boundary definition between glass doors and wooden frame
Consistency of wood grain texture across surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' on the books. Even if the overall shape is correct, nonsensical text is a significant AI artifact. Also, evaluate if the 'painterly' style is masking structural errors in the shelf alignment.
